snippet.title: T△NGENT - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
TANGENT is a momentum-based Foddian platformer about one thing: getting higher, faster.

Swing, pump, launch, and grapple your way through a surreal vertical world. Reach shrines to unlock new movement abilities, master your momentum, and find faster routes to the top.

Every run is a chance to move cleaner, climb higher, and beat your best time.
